text:
I added `moving_average(nums, k)` as a new module, `shop.movavg`, with tests. All 10 tests pass.

- **`src/shop/movavg.py`**: returns a list of floats, one mean per window of `k` consecutive numbers, so `len(nums) - k + 1` values. It raises `ValueError` if `k < 1` or `k > len(nums)`, which also covers empty input. It accepts any iterable and does not modify the input. It uses a running sum, so it runs in O(n).
- **`tests/test_movavg.py`**: covers basic windows, `k=1`, `k == len`, floats and negatives, iterable input, input not being mutated, `k` of 0 or -1, `k` larger than the list, and empty input.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: added an entry under Unreleased referencing PAY-4108.

The repo isn't a git repository, so I didn't commit anything. pytest wasn't installed system-wide, so I ran the tests from a venv at `/tmp/movavg-venv`, outside the repo.
prompt: Add a new feature called movavg to this package (ticket PAY-4108). It should provide moving_average(nums, k), returning a list of floats with the mean of every window of k consecutive numbers. Raise ValueError if k is less than 1 or larger than len(nums). Also add tests.
